questions.question: When was atorvastatin first prescribed, and at what dose?
Was the dose change from 20 mg to 40 mg ever implemented or documented as ordered?
What was the most recent cholesterol test result, and when was it performed?
Has the patient reported any muscle symptoms or adverse effects since starting atorvastatin?
Was pharmacy confirmation of the 20 mg dose preceded by a clinician order or note about continuing or reducing the dose?
Are there prior entries indicating rationale for choosing 20 mg over 40 mg (e.g., intolerance, renal function, age)?
